title: %ifElse - choose a value on a condition
purpose: Return one of two values depending on a boolean condition.
notes: The condition is a verb-expression (%gt @.amount ##1000), evaluated left-to-right - not a quoted infix string.
ifElse calls nest: the else branch can be another %ifElse for multi-way classification.

avoid.why: a quoted string is a literal, always truthy-or-not as data - it is never parsed as a condition; the comparison silently never fires. Use %gt @.amount ##1000
